implicit_assumptions.description: The identity precompile is always available at address 0x04 on mainnet and compatible chains
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Contracts relying on identity for memory copy operations would fail

implicit_assumptions.description: Empty input data (0 bytes) is valid and results in empty output
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Contracts passing empty data could encounter unexpected behavior

implicit_assumptions.description: The identity precompile performs no validation or transformation on input data
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If data were modified, contracts using identity for data integrity could be compromised

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker can provide arbitrarily large input data limited only by gas costs
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Size restrictions could affect gas cost assumptions for DoS resistance
